author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v2.1.0: Tuya protocol 3.5 support (AES-GCM), rewritten protocol layer, data points fixed for ywcgq sensors, optional persistent connection with heartbeat. Protocol 3.1 and hostname support removed: use the sensor's IP.

x-catalog.description: Local driver for Tuya Wi-Fi ultrasonic tank level sensors (port 6668, protocols 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5), with no Tuya Cloud. Level, water column and alarm state, plus optional volume calculation.
